notes.title: We are at GamesCom!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that Bravehood we are attending GamesCom!

As Blackburne Games, we are at Gamescom held in Cologne between 23-27 August. We will be in front of you precious players with Ex Natura, Borderwatch: Dark Armada and Bravehood. We want to see you all among us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43846440/87bff99a76465005247872722369adc87ddd55dd.png[/img]

notes.title: Developer Plays - Borderwatch: Dark Armada NextFest
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43769289/caf589c4f864c7dbc522c1aaf20b80d779857c23.png[/img]

Dear players,

Borderwatch Dark Armada Demo is now playable at Steam NextFest! Our developer will play and answer your questions about the game. Don't forget to try it with your friends!

Thanks!

--

What to expect from our community?

* Meeting up with fellow cultists!
* Our game giveaways
* Sneak Peaks from our newest creations
* News about our upcoming games
* Being a part of a great family 🙂

We wish to see you on our livestream, 👋

You can also follow us from these links

https://linktr.ee/Blackburne

notes.title: Challenge each other with the hashtag #Suvive10Days
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1068145276302413956/1094911392982769724/1024x768__.jpg[/img]
   
   Challenge each other with the hashtag #Suvive10Days. Borderwatch is a game where you and your friends try to survive for 10 days. Strategize with your friends with dynamic weather and day conditions. Survive and get on the helicopter after 10 days.
